original_source: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) Monthly & Annual API, NASA Langley Research Center; meteorological parameters from MERRA-2 (NASA GMAO)
retrieval_method: HTTPS GET issued from a Chrome browser on the team's computer (the build sandbox had no route to power.larc.nasa.gov); SHA-256 computed in the browser on the response body and matched after the body was stored in the repository (byte-identical)

PRECTOTCORR.kind: model reanalysis (assimilates satellite and conventional observations); not a direct measurement

RH2M.kind: model reanalysis (assimilates satellite and conventional observations); not a direct measurement

T2M.kind: model reanalysis (assimilates satellite and conventional observations); not a direct measurement

spatial_resolution: MERRA-2 native grid, 0.5 deg latitude x 0.625 deg longitude; a point query returns the enclosing grid cell, at the grid cell's mean elevation (per POWER documentation)
temporal_resolution: monthly means (keys YYYY01..YYYY12) plus the API's annual mean (YYYY13)

validation_checks.check: calendar complete and identical for all variables
YYYY13 annual summaries separated from the 12 calendar months
our day-weighted annual means agree with the API's own annual values
